## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug` passes locally

- [ ] No secrets, keystores or real configs are committed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` (Unreleased) and README are updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Add the `run-instrumented` label if the change touches services, storage or the release build
